findings.title: No cluster policies defined
findings.message: A Databricks workspace exists but no databricks_cluster_policy is defined anywhere in the project. Without policies, users can create clusters with any configuration, which is how costs and environment drift get out of hand.

findings.title: Stateful resource missing lifecycle protection
findings.message: Resource 'azurerm_storage_account.unity_catalog' is stateful but has no lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }. An accidental terraform destroy could delete this resource and its data.

findings.title: Storage account TLS version relies on provider default
findings.message: Storage account 'unity_catalog' does not set min_tls_version. The provider defaults new accounts to TLS1_2, so this is fine today; set it explicitly so the intent is visible in review.
